items.title: Sources: Anthropic potential $900B+ valuation round could happen within 2 weeks

items.title: OpenAI announces new advanced security for ChatGPT accounts, including a partnership with Yubico

items.description: In a federal courtroom in California on Thursday, Elon Musk testified that his own AI startup, xAI, has used OpenAI's models to improve its own. items.tldr: TL;DR: イーロン・マスクは、彼のAIスタートアップxAIがOpenAIのモデルを使用してGrokをトレーニングしたと証言した。これはモデル蒸留という業界で一般的な手法に関連している。

items.title: Elon Musk testifies that xAI trained Grok on OpenAI models
items.description: "Distillation" is a hot topic as frontier labs try to prevent smaller competitors from copying their models.

items.title: FDA approval, fundraising, and the reality of building in healthcare according to BioticsAI founder

items.description: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are facing off in a high-stakes trial that could alter the future of OpenAI and its most well-known product, ChatGPT.
